`truncateMiddle(text, max)` is now in `src/cli/truncate.ts`, with tests in `test/cli/truncate.test.ts`, and the work is committed. `npm run fast` passed before the last edit. That edit only moved one line in `scripts/lib/shard-weights.mjs`, and I didn't re-run the checks afterwards.

- **Behaviour:** text that already fits in `max` comes back unchanged. Otherwise the middle becomes a single `…` and the result is exactly `max` characters long. The head gets the extra character when the kept count is odd, so `truncateMiddle('abcdefghij', 6)` gives `abc…ij`.
- **Edge cases:** `max` of 1 gives `…`, and `max` below 1 gives an empty string. Length is counted in code points, so emoji aren't split.
- **Shard weight:** the repo has a rule test requiring every test file to have a shard weight. I added `'test/cli/truncate.test.ts': 0.1` to `scripts/lib/shard-weights.mjs`. Without it, `npm run fast` failed.
- **Notes:** the plan and decisions are in `docs/truncate-middle-notes.md`, and I ticked the steps off as I went.
